help.title: About Bookings
help.overview: A booking puts a marketplace order on the calendar: a start and end time, with the timezone it was agreed in. Use it when the work happens at an appointment, not only by a due date.

sections.title: Creating
items: Either party of the order can book it, while the order is accepted or in progress.
One booking per order. The provider is taken from the order.

sections.title: Changing
items: Only the provider, or an administrator, reschedules.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
Non-administrators see only the bookings of their own orders.
